name: deepblending
description: DeepBlending is a vision benchmark/dataset for image composition and blending, providing paired composite and ground-truth images to evaluate image harmonization and blending algorithms. It measures how well models can produce visually coherent composites that match real images in color, lighting, and texture. Common evaluations focus on reconstruction and perceptual quality.
general_score_metric: PSNR / SSIM (with FID for perceptual quality)
reputation: Moderately used in image composition and harmonization research as a standard dataset for quantitatively comparing blending methods.
